arxiv-2209-03234.title: Hadronic vacuum polarization correction to atomic energy levels
arxiv-2209-03234.creator: S. Breidenbach, E. Dizer, H. Cakir, Z. Harman
arxiv-2209-03234.description: Abstract The shift of atomic energy levels due to hadronic vacuum polarization is evaluated in a semi-empirical way for hydrogenlike ions and for muonic hydrogen. A parametric hadronic polarization function obtained from experimental cross sections of e − ​ e + e^{-}e^{+} annihilation into hadrons is applied to derive an effective relativistic Uehling potential.

arxiv-2306-08130.title: Quasi-Periodic Peak Energy Oscillations in X-ray Bursts from SGR J1935+2154
arxiv-2306-08130.creator: Oliver J. Roberts, Matthew G. Baring, Daniela Huppenkothen, Ersin Göğüş, Yuki Kaneko, Chryssa Kouveliotou, Lin Lin, Alexander J. van der Horst, George Younes
arxiv-2306-08130.description: Abstract Magnetars are young neutron stars powered by the strongest magnetic fields in the Universe (10 13-15 G). Their transient X-ray emission usually manifests as short (a few hundred milliseconds), bright, energetic ( ∼ \sim 10 40-41 erg) X-ray bursts.

arxiv-2307-15771.title: The Hydra Effect: Emergent Self-repair in Language Model Computations
arxiv-2307-15771.creator: Thomas McGrath, Matthew Rahtz, János Kramár, Vladimir Mikulik, Shane Legg
arxiv-2307-15771.description: Abstract We investigate the internal structure of language model computations using causal analysis and demonstrate two motifs: (1) a form of adaptive computation where ablations of one attention layer of a language model cause another layer to compensate (which we term the Hydra effect) and (2) a counterbalancing function of late MLP layers that act to downregulate the maximum-likelihood token.

arxiv-2308-03887.title: Enhancing Yeast Cell Tracking with a Time-Symmetric Deep Learning Approach
arxiv-2308-03887.creator: Gergely Szabó, Paolo Bonaiuti, Andrea Ciliberto, András Horváth
arxiv-2308-03887.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gergely Szabó, Paolo Bonaiuti, Andrea Ciliberto, András Horváth. The accurate tracking of live cells using video microscopy recordings remains a challenging task for popular state-of-the-art image processing based object tracking methods. In recent years, several existing and new applications have attempted to integrate deep-learning based frameworks for this task, but most of them still heavily rely on consecutive frame based tracking embedded in their architecture or other premises that hinder generalized learning.

arxiv-2404-07884.title: New horizons for inhomogeneous quenches and Floquet CFT
arxiv-2404-07884.creator: Hanzhi Jiang, and Márk Mezei
arxiv-2404-07884.description: Abstract A fruitful avenue in investigating out-of-equilibrium quantum many-body systems is to abruptly change their Hamiltonian and study the subsequent evolution of their quantum state. If this is done once, the setup is called a quench, while if it is done periodically, it is called Floquet driving.

arxiv-2406-04010.title: Positive definiteness of fourth order three dimensional symmetric tensors
arxiv-2406-04010.creator: Yishenhg Song
arxiv-2406-04010.description: Abstract For a 4th order 3-dimensional symmetric tensor with its entries 1 1 or − 1 -1 , we show the analytic sufficient and necessary conditions of its positive definiteness. By applying these conclusions, several strict inequalities is bulit for ternary quartic homogeneous polynomials. 0 0 footnotetext: The author’s work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of P.R.

arxiv-2412-11183.title: Occ Scene : Semantic Occ upancy-based Cross-task Mutual Learning for 3D Scene Generation Thanks: Bohan Li is with the School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China, and Ningbo Institute of Digital Twin, Eastern Institute of Technology, Ni
arxiv-2412-11183.creator: Bohan Li, Xin Jin, Jianan Wang, Yukai Shi, Yasheng Sun, Xiaofeng Wang, Zhuang Ma
arxiv-2412-11183.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Bohan Li, Xin Jin, Jianan Wang, Yukai Shi, Yasheng Sun, Xiaofeng Wang, Zhuang Ma. Recent diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable performance in both 3D scene generation and perception tasks. Nevertheless, existing methods typically separate these two processes, acting as a data augmenter to generate synthetic data for downstream perception tasks. In this work, we propose OccScene , a novel mutual learning paradigm that integrates fine-grained 3D perception and high-quality generation in a unified framework, achieving a cross-task win-win effect.

arxiv-2509-03530.title: Reading Between the Signs: Predicting Future Suicidal Ideation from Adolescent Social Media Texts
arxiv-2509-03530.creator: Paul Blum, Enrico Liscio, Ruixuan Zhang, Pradeep K. Murukannaiah
arxiv-2509-03530.description: Abstract Suicide is a leading cause of death among adolescents (aged 12–18), yet predicting it remains a significant challenge. Many cases go undetected because young people often do not contact mental health services. In contrast, young people often share their thoughts and struggles online in real time.

arxiv-2601-10630.title: Classification Imbalance
arxiv-2601-10630.description: Abstract Classification imbalance arises when one class is much rarer than the other. We frame this setting as transfer learning under label (prior) shift between an imbalanced source distribution induced by the observed data and a balanced target distribution under which performance is evaluated.

It is known that neural cells can regulate brain vascular integrity. However, due to the high complexity of...

pmc-10601237.title: Complications of unintentional dural puncture during labour epidural analgesia: a 10-year retrospective observational study
pmc-10601237.creator: S Poma, M C Bonomo, G Gazzaniga, M Pizzulli, A De Silvestri, C Baldi, F Broglia, M Ciceri, M Fuardo, F Morgante, S Pellicori, E M Roldi, M P Delmonte, F Mojoli, A Locatelli
pmc-10601237.description: IntroductionUnintentional dural puncture (UDP) occurs in 0.5–1.5% of labour epidural analgesia cases. To date, little is known about evidence of UDP-related complications. This work aimed to assess the incidence of intrapartum and postpartum complications in parturients who experienced UDP.MethodsThis is a 10-year retrospective observational study on parturients admitted to our centre who presented UDP.

pmc-10659755.title: Correlation between immune‐related Tryptophan‐Kynurenine pathway and severity of severe pneumonia and inflammation‐related polyunsaturated fatty acids
pmc-10659755.creator: Baojun Guo, Mingshan Xue, Teng Zhang, Hui Gan, Runpei Lin, Mingtao Liu, Yuhong Liao, Jiali Lyu, Peiyan Zheng, Baoqing Sun
pmc-10659755.description: BackgroundImmune dysfunction and oxidative stress caused by severe pneumonia can lead to multiple organ dysfunction and even death, causing a significant impact on health and the economy. Currently, great progress has been made in the diagnosis and treatment of this disease, but the mortality rate remains high (approximately 50%).

pmc-10744813.title: A Literature Review of Incorporating Crack Tip Plasticity into Fatigue Crack Growth Models
pmc-10744813.creator: Antonio Garcia-Gonzalez, Jose A. Aguilera, Pablo M. Cerezo, Cristina Castro-Egler, Pablo Lopez-Crespo
pmc-10744813.description: This paper presents an extensive literature review focusing on the utilisation of crack tip plasticity as a crucial parameter in determining and enhancing crack growth models. The review encompasses a comprehensive analysis of various methodologies, predominantly emphasising numerical simulations of crack growth models while also considering analytical approaches.

pmc-11450892.title: Artificial Intelligence–Enhanced Electrocardiography Identifies Patients With Normal Ejection Fraction at Risk of Worse Outcomes
pmc-11450892.creator: Jwan A Naser, Eunjung Lee, Francisco Lopez-Jimenez, Peter A Noseworthy, Omar S Latif, Paul A Friedman, Grace Lin, Jae K Oh, Christopher G Scott, Sorin V Pislaru, Zachi I Attia, Patricia A Pellikka
pmc-11450892.description: BackgroundAn artificial intelligence (AI)-based electrocardiogram (ECG) model identifies patients with a higher likelihood of low ejection fraction (EF). Patients with an abnormal AI-ECG score but normal EF (false positives; FP) more often developed future low EF.ObjectiveThe purpose of this study was to evaluate echocardiographic characteristics and all-cause mortality risk in FP patients.

pmc-11459406.title: Advancing infrared and visible image fusion with an enhanced multiscale encoder and attention-based networks
pmc-11459406.creator: Jiashuo Wang, Yong Chen, Xiaoyun Sun, Hui Xing, Fan Zhang, Shiji Song, Shuyong Yu
pmc-11459406.description: SummaryInfrared and visible image fusion aims to produce images that highlight key targets and offer distinct textures, by merging the thermal radiation infrared images with the detailed texture visible images. Traditional auto encoder-decoder-based fusion methods often rely on manually designed fusion strategies, which lack flexibility across different scenarios.

pmc-11515535.title: The effect of mesoporous silica doped with silver nanoparticles on glass ionomer cements; physiochemical, mechanical and ion release analysis
pmc-11515535.creator: Syed Saad Bin Qasim, Ali Bmuajdad
pmc-11515535.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe purpose of the study was to evaluate the effect of adding mesoporous silica with silver nanoparticles to conventional glass ionomer cements (GIC) on its, physical, chemical, mechanical properties and ion release analysis.MethodsSynthesized mesoporous silica with silver nanoparticles were added in 1, 3 and 5% by weight to the liquid component of GIC forming three experimental groups and compared with plain GIC as control group. Physical and chemical characterization were conducted using nano-computerized tomography (NanoCT) and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy.

pmc-12564954.title: Comparative Effectiveness of SGLT2i and GLP-1RA on Blood Pressure in Hypertensive Patients with Type 2 Diabetes: A Saudi Multicenter Retrospective Study
pmc-12564954.creator: Ghadah Alshehri, Raghad Alrashidi, Renad Alhaqbani, Reema Almeshari, Nader Bin Sheraim, Alwaleed Alharbi, Majed S. Al Yami, Abdulmohsen Alanazi, Nourah Alsalamah, Amani Alrossies
pmc-12564954.description: Background/Objectives: Sodium–glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) have shown blood pressure (BP) reduction in type 2 diabetes (T2D). However, head-to-head comparisons in hypertensive patients remain limited. This study assessed the effects of SGLT2i and GLP-1RA on systolic BP (SBP), diastolic BP (DBP), antihypertensive regimen modifications, and adverse events in Saudi patients with both conditions.

pmc-12581542.title: LEAST as a novel prediction model of hepatocellular carcinoma development in patients with chronic hepatitis B: a multi-center study
pmc-12581542.creator: Jingjing Song, Jie Li, Zhigang Ren, Wen Xie, Jinhua Shao, Xiaoxiao Zhang, Yang Zhou, Fajuan Rui, Xiaoqing Wu, Qiuling Wang, Zuxiong Huang, Chao Sun, Yuemin Nan
pmc-12581542.description: BackgroundConsidering the heavy burden on healthcare resources owing to HBV infection and the broad feasibility of transient elastography techniques in China, we aimed to construct and corroborate a liver stiffness measure (LSM)-dictated prediction model concerning hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) development among CHB patients.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted, involving 713 consecutive patients with CHB.

pmc-13454344.title: Echo state network-based model reference adaptive predefined time control for magnetic levitation linear synchronous motor
pmc-13454344.creator: Yunpeng Sun, Wanning Bai, Zelai Xu, Anying Chai, Haoluan Li, Jiarun Wang
pmc-13454344.description: To enhance the transient performance and robustness of a magnetic levitation linear synchronous motor, this paper proposes an echo state network (ESN)-based model reference adaptive predefined-time control. The proposed preset time speed error reference model enables users to define the decay rate of the tracking error and the convergence time required for the speed error to reach zero.

pmc-13485540.title: Case Report: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma presenting with cauda equina syndrome: a rare case and diagnostic dilemma
pmc-13485540.creator: Xu-yang Zhang, Han-sheng Fang, Xin-yue Liu, Hai-dan Chen, Hui-li Cai
pmc-13485540.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the clinical and diagnostic characteristics of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma (IVLBCL) presenting primarily as cauda equina syndrome (CES), analyze factors contributing to diagnostic delay, and evaluate the diagnostic value of minimally invasive biopsy.MethodsWe report a case of IVLBCL that initially presented with CES.

pmc-13602037.title: Roles and perceived responsibilities of investigators and pharmacists in the monitoring of drug-drug interactions in clinical trials - a mixed methods study
pmc-13602037.creator: Anne-Jaël Elskamp, Shirley Cao, Gijsbert Schouten-Ritskes, Joris van der Post, Jacqueline Hugtenburg, Niels Vermeer
pmc-13602037.description: PurposeTo explore the roles and perceived responsibilities of clinical investigators and pharmacists in the monitoring of drug-drug interactions (DDIs) between study medication and concomitant medication in clinical trials. Secondly, sharing of information on study medication treatment with community and hospital outpatient pharmacies was investigated.

pmc-13658030.title: Experimental randomness amplification
pmc-13658030.creator: Anatoly Kulikov, Simon Storz, Josua D. Schär, Martin Sandfuchs, Ramona Wolf, Florence Berterottière, Christoph Hellings, Andreas Wallraff, Renato Renner
pmc-13658030.description: Realistic quantum information processing devices are inherently imperfect, leading to computational errors that require quantum error correction. Likewise, random bits generated by such devices are flawed and must be enhanced to be usable for applications such as generating cryptographic keys. This enhancement of randomness quality is achieved through a protocol known as randomness amplification1.
